items.title: *The Week in 15 Selections*
items.content:
One million years have passed since the last newsletter (7 days). Millennial Optimism is back. Texas is Blue. The Iowa Governor was a Tumblr hottie. Mississippi (Mississippi!) is on the verge of electing a black democrat to Senate. The leaves are falling, and the sky is dark in the afternoon.

On to the links. There are so many interesting things to read and see this week:

  1. I am thinking again about this Giamatti quote about baseball because the Brewers won the World Series and now we must face winter alone yet again.

“[Baseball] breaks your heart. It is designed to break your heart. The game begins in the spring, when everything else begins again, and it blossoms in the summer, filling the afternoons and evenings, and then as soon as the chill rains come, it stops and leaves you to face the fall alone”
